steps.title: Drop off
steps.body: Bring devices to a Compudopt drop-off location or a partner Micro Center. Ask for a tax receipt.

steps.title: Data wiped
steps.body: Staff erase every drive to the NIST 800-88 standard, a multi-pass wipe so no data survives.

steps.title: Refurbish or recycle
steps.body: Usable machines are refurbished. Anything that can't be reused goes to R2 or e-Stewards certified recyclers.

steps.title: Delivered free
steps.body: Refurbished computers go free to families and students who don't have one at home.

donation.brokenOk: Broken computers and computers missing cords are accepted as long as the hard drive is intact.
donation.microCenterNote: Micro Center drop-off takes working laptops and desktops only.

stories.name: Carlos
stories.story: On his first day, he and a friend were the only students without a laptop or iPad. He was already working and paying bills and panicked. Through the college's new partnership with Compudopt, his adviser told him Compudopt had donated a computer for him. He now uses it every day and is working with Compudopt himself.
